# Raxol

> Multi-surface runtime for Elixir on OTP. One TEA module renders to a terminal, a browser (LiveView), an SSH session, MCP, Telegram, a watch, and speech. Agents get skills, tools, and agentic commerce.

## Quick start

    {:raxol, "~> 2.8"}                 # add to mix.exs

## Capability summary

Raxol is an Elixir framework built on OTP. It uses The Elm Architecture (TEA): init/1, update/2, view/1. The same module renders to these surfaces without modification: terminal, liveview, ssh, mcp, telegram, watch, speech.

Agent framework: TEA agents (message-driven) and Process agents (tick-driven), teams with coordinator/worker supervision, reasoning strategies (Direct, ReAct), and skills in the agentskills.io SKILL.md format. Backends: Anthropic, OpenAI, Kimi, OpenRouter, LongCat, DeepSeek, Proton Lumo, Ollama, LM Studio, LLM7, Mock.

Agent commerce: autonomous payments (x402, MPP, Xochi cross-chain), spending limits, stealth and shielded settlement, and ZKSAR trust attestations. No other agent runtime ships this.

Governance: a tool marked sensitive is denied unless the call's context carries an authorizer that allows it.

## Surfaces

- terminal (termbox2 NIF, raxol_terminal)
- liveview (Phoenix PubSub, raxol_liveview)
- ssh (Erlang :ssh, raxol (built-in))
- mcp (stdio JSON-RPC, raxol_mcp)
- telegram (Telegex HTTP, raxol_telegram)
- watch (APNS/FCM push, raxol_watch)
- speech (TTS/STT (say/Whisper), raxol_speech)

## Packages

- raxol `{:raxol, "~> 2.8"}`: Full framework
- raxol_agent `{:raxol_agent, "~> 2.7"}`: AI agents
- raxol_mcp `{:raxol_mcp, "~> 2.8"}`: MCP server
- raxol_liveview `{:raxol_liveview, "~> 2.8"}`: LiveView bridge
- raxol_sensor `{:raxol_sensor, "~> 2.8"}`: Sensor fusion
- raxol_terminal `{:raxol_terminal, "~> 2.8"}`: Terminal emulation
- raxol_core `{:raxol_core, "~> 2.8"}`: Behaviours, events
- raxol_journal `{:raxol_journal, "~> 2.8"}`: Session journal
- raxol_plugin `{:raxol_plugin, "~> 2.8"}`: Plugin SDK
- raxol_speech `{:raxol_speech, "~> 0.3"}`: TTS/STT
- raxol_telegram `{:raxol_telegram, "~> 0.3"}`: Telegram bot
- raxol_watch `{:raxol_watch, "~> 0.3"}`: Push notifications

## MCP integration

    {
      "mcpServers": {
        "raxol": {
          "command": "mix",
          "args": ["mcp.server"],
          "cwd": "/path/to/your/raxol/app"
        }
      }
    }

Built-in headless tools: raxol_start, raxol_screenshot, raxol_send_key, raxol_get_model, raxol_stop, raxol_list.
